scripts.test: jest --testPathIgnorePatterns=extension.e2e.test.js scraper.contract.test.mjs network.security.mjs background.security.test.mjs storage.security.test.mjs wishlist.security.test.mjs content.security.e2e.mjs

scripts.test:security: node --test src/__tests__/network.security.mjs && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules node --test src/__tests__/background.security.test.mjs src/__tests__/storage.security.test.mjs src/__tests__/wishlist.security.test.mjs && node --test src/__tests__/content.security.e2e.mjs
